test_title: SSC Stenographer 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 10 Dec, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following is NOT a correct statement about the light-independent reactions of photosynthesis?

options.text: They use energy from ATP and NADPH to produce glucose.
They use energy from ATP and NADPH to produce oxygen.
They take place in the stroma of the chloroplasts.
They are also known as the Calvin cycle.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The light-independent reactions (Calvin cycle) do not produce oxygen; instead, they utilize ATP and NADPH to fix carbon dioxide into organic compounds like glucose.
 
• Oxygen is generated during the light-dependent reactions, not the light-independent reactions.
 
• These reactions take place in the stroma of the chloroplasts and play a crucial role in carbon fixation.
 
• The Calvin cycle is essential for synthesizing glucose, which serves as an energy source for plants and other organisms.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1:** Correct - The Calvin cycle uses ATP and NADPH to convert carbon dioxide into glucose.
 
• **Option 3:** Correct - The light-independent reactions occur in the stroma of the chloroplasts.
 
• **Option 4:** Correct - The light-independent reactions are also known as the Calvin cycle.
